title: Replacement Supply for Lost Medication — Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit Calculation Standard
content:
**Calculation.** Under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, the replacement supply for lost, stolen or damaged medication of the drug of the member's most recent home delivery shipment is defined as follows.

1. The lost supply is the member's most recent paid retail claim for the drug, and its days run from its date of service, that date being day zero.
2. The lost days are the days of the lost supply not yet run out today: its days supply less the calendar days from its date of service to today.
3. The replacement supply is the lost days, never below zero, rounded down to whole days.

## Worked figures (hypothetical records)

| Most recent paid retail claim for the drug | Today | Lost days | Replacement supply |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 days, dated day 0 | Day 12 | 18 | 18 |
| 90 days, dated day 0 | Day 30 | 60 | 60 |
| 30 days, dated day 0 | Day 30 | 0 | 0 |
| 30 days, dated day 0 | Day 34 | less than zero | 0 (never below zero) |

## Reading the definition

The lost days are counted as of today, the day the replacement is sized, from the lost supply's own date of service.
